heading: INT. NEON BOWLING ALLEY - KARAOKE NIGHT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NEON BOWLING ALLEY - KARAOKE NIGHT - NIGHT
Strobe lights, disco pins, a bad ballad echoing through the lanes.
LT. NAOMI FINCH (40s, leather jacket) leans against the shoe counter, eyes on a booth in the back.
DWAYNE "SPUD" CARTWRIGHT (30s, too-bright shirt) is at the karaoke mic, mid-song, glancing at a briefcase beside the booth.
The briefcase sits beside OSKAR VLASIC (50s, fur collar), who nurses a soda.
Behind the counter, BETH (20s, name tag, skeptical) polishes shoes.
Baby, I'm just a fool for the way you walk away.
units.name: SPUD

units.text: Finch pushes off the counter and crosses the lane.
Oskar sees her.
His hand slides to the briefcase.

Spud drops the mic mid-note, Finch draws, Oskar yanks the briefcase free, and in a single tangle of limbs Beth ducks, Spud lunges, Oskar sprints for the lane gutter, and Finch skids across the polished boards after him as the music blares on.
Police! Stop!
units.name: FINCH

units.text: Not tonight!
units.name: OSKAR

units.text: He hurls the briefcase.
It bursts on the pin deck.
Out spill rental shoe coupons.
Hundreds of them.
Oskar freezes.
Finch freezes.
That's the briefcase?
units.name: FINCH

units.text: It's mine.
units.name: OSKAR

units.text: Shoes!
units.name: SPUD

units.text: Both of you owe me for the lane.
units.name: BETH
